patch_description: Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic geometric maximin search in barycentric coordinates. The search repeatedly performs coordinate-wise linear feasibility improvements: with ten points fixed, every signed triangle area involving the remaining point is affine, so a polygon-clipping feasibility test can maximize that point’s guaranteed minimum area while preserving its current oriented-matroid sign pattern. Multiple seeded starts make the result reproducible while exploring different combinatorial configurations. The resulting reference-triangle coordinates are finally mapped affinely to the requested equilateral triangle.
